item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef chk(req, ev, pol, exp):\\n    req0=copy.deepcopy(req); ev0=copy.deepcopy(ev); pol0=copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)\\n    assert got==exp,(got,exp)\\n    assert (req,ev,pol)==(req0,ev0,pol0)\\n    assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']\\n\\np={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\nbase={'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[dict(base,source='z',value={'q':[1,2]}),dict(base,source='a',value={'q':[1,2]})],p,{'status':'supported','value':{'q':[1,2]},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[dict(base,source='z',value=1),dict(base,source='a',value=2)],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[dict(base,source='old',value=1),dict(base,source='new',value=False,supersedes=['old'])],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})\\nchk({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[dict(base,source='w',value=1,withdrawn=True),dict(base,source='u',value=1,verified=False),dict(base,source='m',value=1,conditions={'a':1,'b':3})],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json') as f: ev=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: pol=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert [evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in rs]==report\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
